initial:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: image 1, the transparent chrome sphere with the accepted two-half knowledge-graph CUTOUT geometry and gold light shining through it. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for the SOFT VOLUMETRIC QUALITY of its upper-left gold beam, not for the number or placement of beams.

Change ONLY the emitted gold light projections from the circular node apertures. Correct the missing lower/side projections and the unequal upper pair. Imagine one isotropic light source at the center of the hollow metal sphere and equal-size circular holes on its front curved surface. Every visible node hole emits the SAME family of soft golden light cones: matching root diameter, opening angle, intrinsic reach and brightness, with coherent perspective. Rays travel straight outward from the sphere center THROUGH the actual holes, following each hole's local radial direction. Include clearly visible lower-left AND lower-right shafts as well as upper-left and upper-right and side-facing holes. Do not just add two upper beams. Adjacent cones must have consistent intensity and reach rather than arbitrary long and short spotlights. Light aimed toward the camera appears foreshortened naturally; peripheral rays show the full soft projection.

Appearance: translucent atmospheric light, bright warm white/gold at the opening, amber-gold in the short surrounding volume, softly widening and fading to nothing with a feathered far end. The aperture itself remains a flat circular hole, not a shaded sphere. Match image 2's approved left soft beam. Cones are made entirely of LIGHT in air, through which the chrome reflections remain visible. No physical tubes, no solid rods, no balloons, no rounded cylindrical caps, no antennas, no opaque surfaces, no cartoon sunburst spikes.

INVARIANTS: preserve the EXACT current cutout graph topology and placement, the clearly separated left/right halves, the continuous thick outer contour and central seam, the thinner internal cut channels, flat node holes, and thin warm metallic cut walls. Preserve sphere size/position, chrome sunset reflections, rainbow neon trails, diagonal foreground neon stroke and its occlusion, lower white glow and all composition. Do not put any new light over the foreground neon in an impossible order. Do not add a logo overlay or raised wires. Preserve alpha transparency, full 1536x1024 landscape framing. No text. This is a lighting-only edit.
